2025-07-24
First notice of loss came in describing a left-turn collision at an intersection. The insured driver is named on the policy,
and nothing suggests the coverage period had lapsed or that the damage predates it.
2025-08-20
Scene photographs show front-quarter and passenger-side damage that is largely in line with the impact as
described. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection history.
2025-10-18
Claimant reports a wrist fracture, and the injury fits the kind and force expected from this type of crash. No earlier
injury to the same area is on record. The claimant has given the same account in every conversation so far.
2025-12-11
The responding officer and the other parties on scene state that the claimant was not in the vehicle when the crash
occurred. No independent witnesses have come forward, and the photographs confirm some details but not the
claimant's position at impact.
2025-12-19
Claimant is now represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney. Treatment has followed a
usual course and tapered off as the patient improved, according to the records received so far.
2026-01-02
File reviewed. Vehicle damage and injury are both broadly consistent with the reported impact. Open items are the
claimant's position at impact and counsel's written response. Reserve maintained pending that review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
